title: Google Fonts
description: The largest free library of open-source fonts, with embed code and variable-font support.

title: Fontsource
description: Self-host open-source fonts as npm packages instead of loading them from a CDN.

title: Bunny Fonts
description: A privacy-first drop-in alternative to Google Fonts, with a compatible API.

title: Fontshare
description: A free font service from Indian Type Foundry with quality families for product UI and branding.

title: Font Squirrel
description: Hand-picked free fonts with commercial licenses, plus a @font-face generator.

title: Modern Font Stacks
description: System font stacks that look great without web-font downloads or layout shift.

title: Fontpair
description: Curated type pairings so you can combine headings and body fonts quickly.

title: Typewolf
description: Typography inspiration: what’s trending, what’s overused, and how sites pair type.

title: Capsize
description: Trim extra space above and below text using real font metrics so type lines up like other UI.

title: Utopia Fluid Type
description: A fluid type-scale calculator that generates clamp()-based CSS for responsive typography.

title: Brick
description: A lightweight, privacy-friendly webfont CDN with a small curated catalog.
